measures.name: status_process_value_add
measures.expression:
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    [Pct_NwMAPE] < [Pct_wMAPE], "The current forecast model performs worse than the Naive forecast",
    [Pct_NwMAPE] > [Pct_wMAPE], "The current forecast model outperforms the Naive forecast",
    "The current forecast model performs the same as the Naive forecast"
)

measures.name: Cumulative_Forecast_Bias
measures.expression:
VAR MaxDateInRow = MAX('dim_calendar'[dt_fsc_month_last])
VAR CurrentDate = TODAY()

RETURN
CALCULATE (
    [Qty_Bias],
    FILTER (
        ALLSELECTED('dim_calendar'), -- Go bo bo loc tren bang ngay de quet toan bo thoi gian
        'dim_calendar'[dt_fsc_month_last] <= MaxDateInRow && 
        'dim_calendar'[dt_fsc_month_last] <= CurrentDate
    )
)
